_comment: Frame source for mash-cv. source=auto tries MuMu's renderer IPC first, then falls back to Windows window capture (PrintWindow on MuMu's nemudisplay render window) when the IPC frame is blank - which is what FLAG_SECURE forces in-game. source=ipc or source=window force a single path; source=scrcpy restores stock behaviour. Delete this file to revert. mumuRoot may stay empty: when it is empty (or points at a stale install) the module auto-detects the MuMu install by locating external_renderer_ipc.dll.
